name: ExpandableSection
description: Collapsible content region with a trigger header. Lighter than `Accordion` (which manages a group of expandables) — used standalone for a single 'show more' or detail-disclosure section.

ariaRequirements: Trigger is a `<button>` with `aria-expanded` reflecting the open state.
Trigger sets `aria-controls` to the panel id; the panel uses `role='region'` and `aria-labelledby` pointing at the trigger.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Bucket-1 beta port: keyboard/ARIA contract reviewed, ForcedColors story added, Storybook axe gate (parameters.a11y.test: error).

forbiddenUse: Use a sequence of `ExpandableSection`s instead of `Accordion` — accordion owns the focus management and single-open behaviour.
Hide critical content (errors, primary CTA) behind a disclosure.
dense: Single disclosure: collapsedLabel/expandedLabel trigger, uncontrolled (defaultExpanded) or controlled (expanded + onExpandedChange); staggered reveal. One section = this; exclusive group = Accordion

usage.description: ExpandableSection is a single, independent disclosure: one trigger whose label can swap between states (`collapsedLabel`/`expandedLabel`), revealing its children with a small stagger. Use it for "show more" tails — extended bios, optional details, long changelogs. It has no group behavior: several ExpandableSections don't know about each other. When sections should be exclusive (open one, close the other), that is Accordion.

bestPractices.description: Give expandedLabel the inverse verb ("Show less") so the trigger always states what it will do.
Use it for optional tails of content, not for the content's opening.
Use controlled mode (expanded + onExpandedChange) when analytics or URL state care about the disclosure.
Keep the reveal short — dozens of children behind one disclosure read as lag; split long lists instead.
Do not build exclusive groups from several ExpandableSections — that is Accordion's contract.
Do not hide required form fields inside; validation errors in collapsed content are invisible.

defaults.children: The optional tail of the content.
